name: Roger
summary: A humanoid for hazardous work such as oil and gas sites, run with shared autonomy: a remote specialist directs the critical actions while onboard AI handles balance, fall recovery and navigation. Minerva was founded in 2025 by ex-Tesla Optimus engineer Sandor Felber and ex-Boston Dynamics engineer Maurice Rahme, and emerged with about US$10M pre-seed in October 2026. Software is developed in the US and prototypes are built near Stuttgart.

sources.title: Minerva Emerges From Stealth With $10M for Humanoids Built for Dangerous Work — Humanoids Daily
